FORMATIONS_BASE_PULSE_ARRAY.why: Every array's Pulse is an action of its own per layer (combat/ext/formations.py: 'Pulse: <Pattern>'), aimed at a creature inside the array, once per named Pulse per creature per round; the Court and Sovereign arrays add a free Pulse each turn and a second Pulse (combat/ext/formation_masters.py).

FORMATIONS_BASE_COLLAPSE_ARRAY.why: 'Collapse Array' (combat/ext/formations.py) ends one of your arrays within 120 feet without an action on your turn, removing its zone, Eye, Nodes and Concentration.

tianxia.talent.formations.binding_array.why: The Binding Pattern is offered as its own Combat Array and Pulse (combat/ext/formations.py); its Passive is Disadvantage on checks and saves to escape a grip your allies put on a hostile inside (the escape_mode hook).

tianxia.talent.formations.sealing_gate_p.why: The Sealing Gate Pattern is offered as its own Combat Array and Pulse; its Passive makes teleporting into, out of or through the array take a Charisma save (the teleport_check hook), and its Pulse blocks teleporting.

tianxia.talent.formations.gate_keeper.why: 'Next array: key a creature' and the Bonus Action Key / Unkey actions set who your arrays treat as keyed (combat/ext/formation_talents.py); a keyed creature is not hostile to the array.

tianxia.talent.formations.collapsing_exi.why: Collapse Array gives a 10-foot move without Opportunity Attacks and Temporary HP if you end that move outside the former array (combat/ext/formation_talents.py).

tianxia.talent.formations.reinforced_nod.why: Eyes and Nodes gain your CL in Hit Points; the Reaction and 1 CP leaves a broken Eye at 1 Hit Point once (combat/ext/formation_talents.py).

tianxia.talent.formations.eye_of_the_for.why: When the Eye would be destroyed or disrupted, you spend a Reaction and 2 CP to keep the array up until the end of your next turn while you stand inside it and are Marked (combat/ext/formation_masters.py: hold).

tianxia.talent.formations.disrupt_node.why: 'Disrupt Node' is an object action on an enemy Eye (combat/ext/formation_talents.py object_action): a Formation Check against the creator's Formation Save DC, the array becomes unstable, and the creator must keep it with a Formation Check.

tianxia.talent.formations.formation_comp.why: Four 'Formation Compass' actions learn one thing about an array within 60 feet (its Eye, whether it needs Concentration, a Pattern Layer, how it would collapse), each a Formation Check against the array's Formation Save DC.

tianxia.talent.formations.array_repair.why: 'Array Repair' restores an Eye's or Node's Hit Points or ends a disruption (combat/ext/formation_talents.py).

tianxia.talent.formations.formation_maze.why: Formation Maze spends a Reaction and 2 Cultivation Points when any part of a hostile creature enters your array or starts its turn inside. A failed Wisdom save prevents voluntary movement closer to the chosen keyed ally, Array Eye, Node or perceived map door/gate at its current position until the start of your next turn. The GM identifies exits without map objects and applies the successful-save movement tax manually: charge 10 additional feet for the next 10 feet actually moved inside, with no turn deadline.

tianxia.talent.formations.reflecting_gat.why: A Reaction and 2 CP when a creature outside your array hits one inside with a ranged attack (Formation Check against the roll: miss, redirect with the same roll, or rebound), or aims a single-target technique at it (against the save DC: it misses) (combat/ext/formation_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.formations.array_that_swa.why: After Formation Devours Technique reduces a technique's damage, 3 CP store what it caught (at most 80); your next Pulse of that array before the end of your next turn may release it with a Formation Attack roll (combat/ext/formation_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.formations.flow_line_stri.why: Originates a Killing Line attack from any Node, and adds PB against a creature crossing a Flow Line or standing between two Nodes; the text does not say which Nodes a Flow Line joins, and the grid engine resolves attacks from the actor's own square. GM adjudicates.

tianxia.talent.formations.nine_palaces_k.why: GM-managed: shared-d20 normal attack pipeline seam unavailable; basic Killing Line Pulse is unchanged.

tianxia.talent.formations.heaven_and_ear.why: Choose five World Laws from a list for a 300-foot-radius sphere for 10 minutes (20 CP, once per week); each Law is a GM-adjudicated rewriting of the surroundings.

tianxia.talent.formations.formation_spir.why: Awakens a minor spirit inside a Prepared Array or project (a 10-minute ritual made outside a fight); it keeps lists, alerts you over 10 miles, and makes impressions.

tianxia.talent.formations.heavenly_grand.why: A project: designing and building a Grand Formation takes a year of work and 50,000 gp of materials.

tianxia.talent.formations.sect_formation.why: A project: designing and building a sect-scale formation takes 30 days and 5,000 gp; 'not a normal combat talent'.

tianxia.talent.formations.hidden_world_g.why: A concealed entrance into a Prepared Array (a 10-minute ritual made outside a fight); entering it is a GM-adjudicated Investigation, Perception or Formation Check.

tianxia.talent.formations.triggered_arra.why: Leaves a completed Prepared Array dormant for up to 24 hours until a trigger the player names; a downtime setup.

tianxia.talent.formations.self_sustainin.why: Makes a completed Prepared Array last 24 hours and Pulse itself on a trigger; a downtime setup.

tianxia.talent.formations.star_vein_astr.why: A benefit chosen when a Prepared, Sect or Grand Formation is built under an auspicious timing the GM decides.

tianxia.talent.formations.vein_tapping_a.why: Binds a Node of a Prepared Array to a natural or artificial power source when the array is set (a 10-minute ritual).

tianxia.talent.formations.hidden_nodes.why: Hides the Nodes and Eye of a Prepared Array when it is set (a 10-minute ritual); finding them is a GM-adjudicated check.
